_note: One of the 20 sets of ichava/icon-sets-extras, each refreshed by its own config into files/<set>/ and licenses/<set>/, with its version recorded at upstream.sets.<set>.current_version in the pack's config.json. svg/free/*.svg, unchanged names. Only the free set: the brand and flag SVGs are CC0 in the same LICENSE, but the brands are trademarks and the flags duplicate icon-sets-flag. CoreUI's LICENSE is its own summary (icons CC-BY-4.0, brands and flags CC0, code MIT) rather than the CC text, so it is pinned by SHA-256. Reproduces the committed pack byte for byte: a dry run at the pinned version against the local checkout on 2026-11-04 wrote 562 SVGs with 0 added, removed or changed.
name: icon-sets-extras-coreui
